{{Top|leg}}
The '''Strategic Planning Forum''' was located on the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine's]] base on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Nickel One]] in the [[Roche system]]. During the [[Second Battle of Roche]], the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] used it as a meeting place, where they were attacked by a team of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. The fight ultimately led to [[Darth Caedus]] dueling his sister [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] in the shot up forum.
